text:
Type: southwestern runner rug
Use: covering a floor, softening a walkway; hallway, kitchen, living room, bedroom
Style: bohemian, traditional, rustic
Materials: low-pile woven synthetic fibers
Colors: dark teal blue, rust orange, cream, navy, terracotta
Shape: long narrow rectangle, repeating diamond medallions in an all-over tribal pattern, patterned border, low flat pile, medium visual weight
Feel: warm, rich, cozy, worldly
Goes with: warm wood floors, navy or dark cabinets, brass accents; bohemian, rustic or traditional rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Southwestern Transitional Area Rug, 4 x 6 Foot, Multi
product.description: Brighten your hallway or other narrow space with this gorgeous Southwest-inspired rug. Rich blues, oranges, and reds interact to create a captivating design that’s distinctly Southwestern and a perfect accent for either contemporary- or vintage-style home decor. 2'6" x 8' Polypropylene Frisee Machine made 0.33 Med
